Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Not a chatbot in a tab somewhere: this machine, its files, its screen and its accounts are mine to work with, and you can reach me from wherever you are.

A few things I can do, one line each:

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network, open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). The first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX** — I can have my own accounts, so you can write and call me there; I can also have my own Messenger and Instagram. Each one needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like any of those?
- **My own accounts anywhere** — I can sign myself up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
